summary:
I am refining an interactive career assistant that provides grounded, responsive answers based on my published site content. This project demonstrates my ability to orchestrate complex, multi-provider LLM workflows with high reliability and safety.

I am also advancing an automated imagery pipeline that uses duotone treatments to ensure a consistent editorial aesthetic across my project pages. This includes experiments with custom photography to maintain an authentic yet stylized presentation.

Additionally, I am integrating an internal messaging broker and a power usage experiment to enhance my local infrastructure. These improvements support the growing complexity of my local AI stack and its automated monitoring.

highlights.oneLiner: A bounded career assistant that answers questions grounded in my site content.
A FastAPI proxy that serializes access to the P100 GPU.
An on-device barbell rep counter using color-plate tracking.
